newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates closed higher on Tuesday as funds ran short, forcing banks to tap the State (central) Bank of Pakistan's discount window, dealers said.
"Yesterday's scarcity of funds crept into the system today as well," a dealer at KASB & Co said.
The dealer said early deals in overnights were struck at 19 percent but lenders raised their offers and heavy amounts were exchanged at 19.75 percent and some at 20 percent.
Midday saw lending rates pegged at 20 percent and the market closed at the same level, he said.
